title: Hyundai Surreal Dreamscape
description: A glowing Hyundai logo encased in a fiery oval portal dominates the center of a dense, surreal collage. The background merges ancient tribal masks, a woman's face with currency over her eyes, fragmented human features, jungle foliage, chains, and layered mystical imagery in deep teal and emerald tones.
prompt: Surreal digital collage featuring a glowing Hyundai logo inside a luminous oval portal with fiery edges at the center. Surrounding it are layered mystical elements including an ornate tribal golden mask on the left, a woman's face with currency notes over her eyes, floating human features, dense jungle ferns, broken chains, and overlapping mystical symbols in a dreamlike composition with heavy teal and emerald atmosphere.
